findings.reason: the roadmap derives its ready-set from this edge, so as written §6 is withheld until §5 closes, contradicting the dispatch order the plan states and leaving an author to re-litigate which part is authoritative.
findings.text: `plan-section-depends-on` declares `"s6":["the-monitor-reads-each-fact-once#s5"]`, but the open followup at line 246 states "§5 and §6 can then start together" (the resolved followup at line 245 agrees), so the declared graph gates §6 behind §5 while the plan's own narrative says they run concurrently

findings.reason: a node implementing §8 as written either keeps the follower's mid-stream reload (contradicting §7/§8) or drops it and sees the named suite fail, so the node cannot satisfy its own done-when without the plan saying whether that test is rewritten to target the station or the subscriber retains a reload path.
findings.text: §8's done-when requires `tests/test_follower_freshness.py` to "pass against the subscriber", but that file's defining test `test_running_follower_reloads_without_stream_or_registration_gap` (tests/test_follower_freshness.py:172) rewrites a module mid-run and asserts the running follower reports the changed behaviour ("fresh:"), i.e. that it reloads onto new code, while §8 line 174 states the subscriber "does not reload" and §7 line 150 says the station "is the only process that reloads"
